sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Bookings"."customer_id" AS e, AVG("Bookings"."count_hired") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("Bookings"."amount_of_refund" - "Bookings"."amount_payable") AS REAL) / "Bookings"."amount_payable")) AS m2 FROM "Bookings" GROUP BY "Bookings"."customer_id"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, ("s1"."m2" - "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10

why: average of number of items hired per Customers (by customer_id)
(refund amount for booking - amount payable for booking) / amount payable for booking: the relative difference of two quantities in USD

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Bookings"."customer_id" AS e, "Customers"."good_or_bad_customer" AS g, AVG("Bookings"."amount_of_discount") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("Bookings"."amount_of_refund" - "Bookings"."amount_payable") AS REAL) / "Bookings"."amount_payable")) AS m2 FROM "Bookings" JOIN "Customers" ON "Customers"."customer_id" = "Bookings"."customer_id"  GROUP BY "Bookings"."customer_id", "Customers"."good_or_bad_customer"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, AVG("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, ("s1"."m2" - "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s1"."g" = "s2"."g" ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Bookings"."customer_id" AS e, "Customers"."gender_mf" AS g, SUM("Bookings"."count_hired") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("Bookings"."amount_payable" - "Bookings"."amount_of_refund") AS REAL) / "Bookings"."amount_of_refund")) AS m2 FROM "Bookings" JOIN "Customers" ON "Customers"."customer_id" = "Bookings"."customer_id"  GROUP BY "Bookings"."customer_id", "Customers"."gender_mf"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, AVG("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, ("s1"."m2" - "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s1"."g" = "s2"."g" WHERE "s1"."m2" > "s2"."v" ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
